async def test_create_writes_rows(pg_pool, tenant_a, team_a):
    async with tenant_tx(pg_pool, tenant_a) as conn:
        wf = await workflow_crud.create_team_workflow(
            conn,
            tenant_id=tenant_a,
            team_id=team_a,
            name="w1",
            stages=[
                {"name": "todo", "ordinal": 0, "is_initial": True},
                {"name": "done", "ordinal": 1, "is_terminal": True},
            ],
            transitions=[{"from_stage": "todo", "to_stage": "done", "requires_reason": False}],
            created_by=tenant_a,
        )
        assert wf.is_active is False
        assert wf.version == 1
        n_wf = await conn.fetchval(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_workflows WHERE workflow_id=$1 AND tenant_id=$2",
            wf.workflow_id,
            tenant_a,
        )
        assert n_wf == 1
        n_stages = await conn.fetchval(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workflow_stages WHERE workflow_id=$1 AND tenant_id=$2",
            wf.workflow_id,
            tenant_a,
        )
        assert n_stages == 2
        n_trans = await conn.fetchval(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workflow_transitions WHERE workflow_id=$1 AND tenant_id=$2",
            wf.workflow_id,
            tenant_a,
        )
        assert n_trans == 1

async def test_activate_one_active_bumps_version(pg_pool, tenant_a, team_a):
    async with tenant_tx(pg_pool, tenant_a) as conn:
        wf1 = await workflow_crud.create_team_workflow(
            conn,
            tenant_id=tenant_a,
            team_id=team_a,
            name="w1",
            stages=[{"name": "todo", "ordinal": 0, "is_initial": True}],
            transitions=[],
            created_by=tenant_a,
        )
        wf2 = await workflow_crud.create_team_workflow(
            conn,
            tenant_id=tenant_a,
            team_id=team_a,
            name="w2",
            stages=[{"name": "todo", "ordinal": 0, "is_initial": True}],
            transitions=[],
            created_by=tenant_a,
        )
        aw = await workflow_crud.activate_workflow(
            conn, tenant_id=tenant_a, team_id=team_a, workflow_id=wf1.workflow_id, actor_tenant_id=tenant_a
        )
        assert aw.is_active is True
        assert aw.version == 2
        with pytest.raises(WorkflowAlreadyActiveError):
            await workflow_crud.activate_workflow(
                conn, tenant_id=tenant_a, team_id=team_a, workflow_id=wf1.workflow_id, actor_tenant_id=tenant_a
            )
        aw2 = await workflow_crud.activate_workflow(
            conn, tenant_id=tenant_a, team_id=team_a, workflow_id=wf2.workflow_id, actor_tenant_id=tenant_a
        )
        assert aw2.is_active is True
        cnt = await conn.fetchval(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_workflows WHERE team_id=$1 AND is_active=TRUE", team_a
        )
        assert cnt == 1


async def test_get_workflow_active_or_named(pg_pool, tenant_a, team_a):
    async with tenant_tx(pg_pool, tenant_a) as conn:
        wf = await workflow_crud.create_team_workflow(
            conn,
            tenant_id=tenant_a,
            team_id=team_a,
            name="w",
            stages=[
                {"name": "todo", "ordinal": 0, "is_initial": True},
                {"name": "done", "ordinal": 1, "is_terminal": True},
            ],
            transitions=[],
            created_by=tenant_a,
        )
        await workflow_crud.activate_workflow(
            conn, tenant_id=tenant_a, team_id=team_a, workflow_id=wf.workflow_id, actor_tenant_id=tenant_a
        )
        g = await workflow_crud.get_workflow(conn, tenant_id=tenant_a, team_id=team_a)
        assert g.workflow_id == wf.workflow_id
        assert [s.ordinal for s in g.stages] == sorted(s.ordinal for s in g.stages)
        g2 = await workflow_crud.get_workflow(conn, tenant_id=tenant_a, team_id=team_a, workflow_id=wf.workflow_id)
        assert g2.workflow_id == wf.workflow_id


async def test_materialise_legacy_idempotent(pg_pool, tenant_a, team_a):
    async with tenant_tx(pg_pool, tenant_a) as conn:
        lid1 = await workflow_crud.materialise_legacy_workflow(conn, tenant_id=tenant_a, team_id=team_a)
        lid2 = await workflow_crud.materialise_legacy_workflow(conn, tenant_id=tenant_a, team_id=team_a)
        assert lid1 == lid2
        stages = await conn.fetch(
            "SELECT name FROM workflow_stages WHERE workflow_id=$1 ORDER BY ordinal", lid1
        )
        assert [r["name"] for r in stages] == list(work_items.WORK_STATUSES)
        row = await conn.fetchrow("SELECT is_active, name FROM team_workflows WHERE workflow_id=$1", lid1)
        assert row["is_active"] is False
        assert row["name"] == workflow_crud.LEGACY_WORKFLOW_NAME
        # transitions never require signoff
        trans = await conn.fetch(
            "SELECT requires_signoff FROM workflow_transitions WHERE workflow_id=$1", lid1
        )
        assert all(r["requires_signoff"] is False for r in trans)
        # transition count matches TRANSITIONS
        assert len(trans) == len(work_items.TRANSITIONS)


async def test_resolve_workflow_null(pg_pool, tenant_a, team_a):
    async with tenant_tx(pg_pool, tenant_a) as conn:
        lid = await workflow_crud.materialise_legacy_workflow(conn, tenant_id=tenant_a, team_id=team_a)
        rid = await work_items._resolve_workflow(conn, tenant_id=tenant_a, team_id=team_a, workflow_id=None)
        assert rid == lid


async def test_workflow_change_preservation(pg_pool, tenant_a, team_a):
    async with pg_pool.acquire() as conn:
        async with conn.transaction():
            root_mem_id = await conn.fetchval(
                """
                INSERT INTO memories (tenant_id, team_id, content, content_hash, embedding, source_kind, type, visibility)
                VALUES ($1, $2, 'r', $3, array_fill(0::real, ARRAY[1024])::vector, 'api', 'question', 'team')
                RETURNING id
                """,
                tenant_a,
                team_a,
                f"h-{uuid4().hex}",
            )
            await conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO memory_maps (root_memory_id, tenant_id, team_id, title, state) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,'m','live')",
                root_mem_id,
                tenant_a,
                team_a,
            )
    async with tenant_tx(pg_pool, tenant_a) as conn:
        legacy_id = await workflow_crud.materialise_legacy_workflow(conn, tenant_id=tenant_a, team_id=team_a)
        await conn.execute(
            """
            INSERT INTO work_items (memory_id, root_memory_id, tenant_id, team_id, kind, created_by, status, status_changed_at, workflow_id, current_stage)
            VALUES ($1, $1, $2, $3, 'story', $2, 'todo', now(), $4, 'todo')
            """,
            root_mem_id,
            tenant_a,
            team_a,
            legacy_id,
        )
        wf_new = await workflow_crud.create_team_workflow(
            conn,
            tenant_id=tenant_a,
            team_id=team_a,
            name="new-wf",
            stages=[{"name": "todo", "ordinal": 0, "is_initial": True}],
            transitions=[],
            created_by=tenant_a,
        )
        await workflow_crud.activate_workflow(
            conn, tenant_id=tenant_a, team_id=team_a, workflow_id=wf_new.workflow_id, actor_tenant_id=tenant_a
        )
        row = await conn.fetchrow(
            "SELECT workflow_id, current_stage FROM work_items WHERE memory_id=$1", root_mem_id
        )
        assert row["workflow_id"] == legacy_id
        assert row["current_stage"] == "todo"

async def test_remap_updates_and_unmapped_keeps(pg_pool, tenant_a, team_a):
    async with pg_pool.acquire() as conn:
        async with conn.transaction():
            root_mem_id = await conn.fetchval(
                """
                INSERT INTO memories (tenant_id, team_id, content, content_hash, embedding, source_kind, type, visibility)
                VALUES ($1, $2, 'r', $3, array_fill(0::real, ARRAY[1024])::vector, 'api', 'question', 'team')
                RETURNING id
                """,
                tenant_a,
                team_a,
                f"h-{uuid4().hex}",
            )
            await conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO memory_maps (root_memory_id, tenant_id, team_id, title, state) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,'m','live')",
                root_mem_id,
                tenant_a,
                team_a,
            )
    async with tenant_tx(pg_pool, tenant_a) as conn:
        await conn.execute(
            """
            INSERT INTO work_items (memory_id, root_memory_id, tenant_id, team_id, kind, created_by, status, status_changed_at, current_stage)
            VALUES ($1, $1, $2, $3, 'story', $2, 'todo', now(), 'todo')
            """,
            root_mem_id,
            tenant_a,
            team_a,
        )
        await conn.execute(
            """
            INSERT INTO work_items (memory_id, root_memory_id, tenant_id, team_id, kind, created_by, status, status_changed_at, current_stage)
            VALUES ($1, $1, $2, $3, 'story', $2, 'todo', now(), 'other')
            """,
            # reuse same root? need distinct node; skip second by using same memory? can't
            root_mem_id,
            tenant_a,
            team_a,
        )
        # remap todo->in_progress
        cnt = await workflow_crud.remap_workflow_stages(
            conn, tenant_id=tenant_a, team_id=team_a, mappings={"todo": "in_progress"}, actor_tenant_id=tenant_a
        )
        assert cnt == 1
        stage = await conn.fetchval("SELECT current_stage FROM work_items WHERE memory_id=$1", root_mem_id)
        assert stage == "in_progress"
